response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery = 22, which is greater than 15. The category-specific electronics rules (priority 20) dominate the standard 30-day window rules (priority 10). RET-003 applies since electronics returns are not accepted after 15 days. No higher-priority rule applies: not defective (RET-020), not final sale (RET-012), no goodwill grant (RET-050), no fraud hold (RET-051).
